title: Understanding the Estimator

title: Expected Value of a Die Roll
text: The expected value of a single roll of a fair 6-sided die is the average of all possible outcomes. Calculate this value.

title: Variance of a Die Roll

title: Calculate the Mean Squared Error
text: Use the formula for mean squared error (MSE) to calculate the MSE of the estimator. The formula is MSE $$=$$ Variance + $${Bias}^2$$. What is the MSE?
